note: Hand-curated quarterly from statutory fiscal documents. CORRECTED 2026-07-27: this note previously said the PDMO site is unreachable from cloud runners (geo-blocked). That is false — pdmo.treasury.go.ke answered HTTP 200 on three consecutive GitHub Actions runs and served a 33-page PDF with a text layer. The unreachability is specific to the container this project is usually developed in, whose egress proxy refuses the host; it was recorded as a fact about the source and was a fact about the runner. Whether the MTDS itself carries a text layer is untested and remains the open question. Update at each MTDS (February) and each supplementary budget.
